Site.name: OpenFoodAlerts
Site.tagline: Official food-safety notifications, archived and explained
Site.disclaimer: OpenFoodAlerts is not an official source and is not affiliated with NVWA, the European Commission or FDA. Information may be delayed or wrong; check the official notification before acting.

Notification.officialIntro: Copied from the Source. Only these fields are official.

Notification.productTypeRule: assigned by an OpenFoodAlerts keyword rule
Notification.aiIntro: Values assigned by the OpenFoodAlerts AI layer are shown here, always marked as AI-made. The official information above takes precedence.
Notification.historyIntro: Every change OpenFoodAlerts observed in the official record.
Notification.reportError: Report an error on this page
Notification.notFoundBody: This notification does not exist, or it concerns a product outside food, feed and food contact materials.

Search.title: Search notifications
Search.metaDescription: Search official food-safety notifications from RASFF, NVWA and openFDA.
Search.intro: Search official food-safety notifications from RASFF, NVWA and openFDA, and narrow them down with the filters.
Search.queryHint: For example: ethylene oxide, "dried figs", salmonella -cheese. Text in Notifications stays in its original language.
Search.officialOnlyHint: Leaves AI classifications of Hazard category, Product category and country of origin out of filters, counts and results.
Search.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No notifications found} one {# notification found} other {# notifications found}}
Search.noResults: Try fewer words or remove a filter.

Alerts.metaDescription: Free daily Digest of official food-safety notifications from RASFF, NVWA and openFDA, filtered your way.
Alerts.heading: Subscribe to email updates
Alerts.intro: Get a daily Digest of new official food-safety notifications that match your filters, and optionally an Instant email for high-priority ones. Free, no account needed, and you can unsubscribe at any time.
Alerts.sourcesHint: Choose at least one. Tick Instant email to also get high-priority notifications right away.
Alerts.instantHint: Instant emails are sent as soon as a matching high-priority notification appears: RASFF alert notifications, FDA Class I recalls and every NVWA food warning. At most 5 per day; the rest go into the Digest.

sourceDescriptions.rasff: EU Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed
sourceDescriptions.nvwa: Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority

Alerts.unclassifiedLabel: Also include notifications without a classification
Alerts.unclassifiedHint: Some notifications have no hazard category, product category or country of origin yet, for example when the AI could not decide. Keep this ticked so you do not miss them.
Alerts.privacyNote: We only store your email address, language and filters, to send these emails. No cookies, no tracking.
Alerts.success: If {email} can receive our emails, a confirmation link is on its way. It is valid for 24 hours; nothing is sent until you confirm.
Alerts.errorInvalid: Please correct the fields marked below.
Alerts.errorConsent: Tick the consent box to subscribe.
Alerts.errorOutdated: This page is out of date. Reload it and try again.
Alerts.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
Alerts.errorServer: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

AlertsConfirm.heading: Confirm your subscription
AlertsConfirm.intro: Press the button to start receiving emails from OpenFoodAlerts.
AlertsConfirm.success: Your subscription is active. You will receive a Digest at 07:00 (Amsterdam time) on days with new matching notifications.
AlertsConfirm.invalid: This confirmation link is not valid or has already been used.
AlertsConfirm.expired: This confirmation link has expired. Please subscribe again.
AlertsConfirm.missing: This page needs the link from your confirmation email. Open the link in the email again.
AlertsConfirm.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
AlertsConfirm.error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

Email.footer: OpenFoodAlerts archives official food-safety notifications from RASFF, NVWA and openFDA. It is not an official source.
Email.reason: You receive this email because this address was entered on {site}.

confirm.subject: Confirm your OpenFoodAlerts subscription
confirm.intro: Someone, hopefully you, asked to receive OpenFoodAlerts emails at this address: a daily Digest of new official food-safety notifications that match these filters.
confirm.validity: This link is valid for 24 hours. Nothing will be sent until you confirm.
confirm.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. The request is deleted automatically after 7 days.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.metaDescription: Official food-safety notifications from RASFF, NVWA and openFDA by Hazard category, Product category, country of origin and month.
Dashboard.intro: Official food-safety notifications per Source, by Hazard category, Product category, country of origin and month. Each Source is counted on its own and never added up: the same incident can appear at more than one Source.
Dashboard.sourceHint: At least one Source stays selected.
Dashboard.officialOnlyHint: Leaves AI classifications of Hazard category, Product category and country of origin out of the filters and the counts.
Dashboard.error: The statistics could not be loaded. Please try again.
Dashboard.scopeNote: Counted: food, feed and food contact material, by publication date; RASFF News is left out. Months are calendar months in Amsterdam time.
Dashboard.total: {count, plural, =0 {No notifications} one {# notification} other {# notifications}}
Dashboard.classifiedNote: With a Hazard category: {hazard}. With a Product category: {product}. With a country of origin: {country}.
Dashboard.timeSeriesLabel: Line chart of notifications per month, one line per Source. The numbers are in the data table.
Dashboard.heatmapHeading: Hazard category × country of origin per month
Dashboard.heatmapHint: Up to {count} most frequent combinations. A notification with several Hazard categories or countries of origin counts in each.
Dashboard.heatmapLabel: Heatmap of notifications per month for each combination of Hazard category and country of origin. The numbers are in the data table.
Dashboard.heatmapEmpty: No notifications with both a Hazard category and a country of origin. NVWA and openFDA do not publish these; they will come from the AI classification.
Dashboard.topLabel: Bar chart: {title}. The numbers are in the data table.
